description: Build a Raycast Script Command at ~/Documents/Raycast/Script Commands/Workspace/workspace.sh that uses a dropdown argument named 'Mode' (values: Focus, Meeting) to switch between two workspace modes. Focus mode must: activate Safari and tile it to the LEFT HALF, activate Notes and tile it to the RIGHT HALF, and set system output volume to 20. Meeting mode must: activate Safari and tile it to the TOP HALF, activate TextEdit and tile it to the BOTTOM HALF, and set system output volume to 70. Use Raycast's window-management deeplinks (raycast://extensions/raycast/window-management/<command>) for the tiling, and osascript for app activation and volume. Make the script executable. The branching must be inside a single script using the dropdown value as $1.
